name: alakazam_ml_v14
model: The v11 distilled LightGBM ranker and v13 feature extractor are unchanged and remain shadow-only by default. v14 is an evidence-driven deterministic runtime correction, not a falsely claimed retraining.
model_scope: Deterministic fallback policy owns all strategic decisions. Live ML override remains disabled by default and the existing guarded scope is unchanged.
ml_override_environment: ALAKAZAM_ML_V14_ENABLE_OVERRIDE=1 (v13 and older aliases remain supported)
v13_rule_changes: Replace Max Rod with the single legal ACE SPEC Enriching Energy.
Treat Enriching Energy as Colorless, never as Psychic fuel for Powerful Hand.
Prioritize attach-to-Dunsparce/Dudunsparce recycle lines, with four-card and seven-card deck-spend gates.
Stop optional Rich Energy draw when the current Active KO and a one-turn backup are already secured.
Reject Boss targets that give fewer prizes than an already available Active KO; equal-prize gusts require a large role/value upgrade.
Block lower-prize Boss targets when the current Active becomes a deterministic KO after non-Supporter evolution/ability/Rich draws later in the same turn.
Reject Powerful Hand into Mist Energy or correctly scoped global effect protection when it would place zero damage counters.
Scope Team Rocket's Articuno protection to Basic Team Rocket Pokemon instead of all opposing Pokemon.
Use Boss to escape an Articuno-protected Active only when a legal unprotected KO exists.
Promote Fezandipiti ex into an alternate attacker plan when every visible target is protected from Powerful Hand.
Track distinct publicly revealed Mist Energy serials and decay the reserve probability by archetype and copies seen.
Reserve only the final Enhanced Hammer, and release it for concrete immediate tempo or when further Mist is no longer plausible.
Keep v11 Teleport targeting; do not inherit the broad v12 Teleport regression.
v14_rule_changes: Prioritize a Psychic attachment that creates a same-turn Active Alakazam attack above Enriching Energy and every competing attachment.
Reject Enriching Energy attachment whenever the Active Alakazam can instead be fueled from hand.
Use an explicit END-turn safety invariant whenever an Active Alakazam attack or enabling attachment is offered.
Restore v11's harmless protected Powerful Hand fallback above END after all useful setup, Boss, and Hammer actions.
Use Boss's Orders to convert a protected Active zero-effect attack into a real unprotected Bench KO, including low-value one-prize Basics.
After a public Mist Energy appears, reserve every Hammer while another copy remains likely; release only when the public-copy prior is exhausted.
Play Hammer immediately against effect-prevention Energy anywhere on the opposing board, with Mist remaining the highest-scored target.
ml_feature_changes: visible Mist copy count and archetype prior
Rich draw-safety and projected net hand delta (+3)
correct Psychic-energy identity excluding Enriching Energy
known_limitations: v13's supplied ladder rating is 807.1; v14 has not yet been submitted, so its rating is unknown and improvement cannot be guaranteed.
The ML model was not retrained because the uploaded agent is runtime-only and contains no training pipeline or labeled training corpus.
